name: Checkout Replay Button
description: Floating circular action button providing replay functionality to re-run timeline step sequences.

starting.description: Resting floating circular button ready for user invocation.

interaction.description: Active click or hover state initiating sequence replay.
interaction.action: Unchecks and re-checks milestone checkboxes in timed intervals (e.g. 800ms) with automated cascade

completed.description: Returned resting state after timeline replay execution completes.
